Acquisition Statement As Per Annx-J, In The

Acquisition And Rehabilitation & Resettlement

 This Petition, Coming On For Order

S, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
 -4-  NC: 2025:KHC:635  WP No. 40580 of 2019 CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.G.S. KAMAL  ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioner brings to the notice of this Court the order dated 16.10.2019 passed in W.P.No.46665/2019 connected with W.P.No.46653/2019 pertaining to the very same subject matter namely acquisition of the property for the purpose of formation of steel flyover.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court while disposing of the aforesaid writ petitions had observed that the properties of the petitioners sought to be made use of by the respondent - BBMP could be taken only if it is required for the purpose of project and after compliance with the applicable provisions of law.
3. Learned counsel further submits that properties of the petitioner has not been utilized by the respondent-BBMP and the flyover construction has NC: 2025:KHC:635 been completed.

As such,
the petition has become infructuous.
